ruleDefinitions.name: Process Access via TrolleyExpress Exclusion
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a possible process memory dump that uses the white-listed Citrix TrolleyExpress.exe filename as a way to dump the lsass process memory

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\TrolleyExpress\\ 7.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\TrolleyExpress\\ 8.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\TrolleyExpress\\ 9.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\TrolleyExpress\\\.exe\\ 7.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\TrolleyExpress\\\.exe\\ 8.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\TrolleyExpress\\\.exe\\ 9.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\TrolleyExpress\\\.exe\\ \\-ma\\ .*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\TrolleyExpress\\\.exe$") AND  NOT (process_original_file_name = RGX(".*CtxInstall.*") OR process_original_file_name = "None"))
